short: Advanced Fertility Center of Texas is a leading provider of personalized fertility care, offering advanced reproductive treatments and holistic wellness services. Serving patients across Texas and nationwide, we specialize in IVF, IUI, egg freezing, donor services, genetic testing, and male fertility treatments. With a patient-centered approach, we provide remote consultations, same-day testing, and fertility-focused acupuncture and wellness programs to optimize reproductive health and outcomes.
long: Advanced Fertility Center of Texas (AFCT) provides compassionate, personalized fertility care led by Dr. Allon. We specialize in complex cases with services including IVF, ICSI, IUI, ovarian rejuvenation, donor programs, PCOS fertility treatment, and genetic testing (PGT). With locations in Houston, College Station & Woodlands, AFCT combines advanced lab science with an integrative approach focused on egg and sperm quality and underlying health factors for both partners. Our concierge model offers individualized care, same-day testing, telemedicine, after-hours consults, and outside monitoring for out-of-state patients. With expertise in challenging cases and a world-class IVF lab, AFCT delivers advanced treatment with compassion and hope.
